name: ineq
resume: All 31 public functions and the Ilocos dataset are done. Inequality, concentration, poverty, and Lorenz curves are NumPy. The normal cdf, normal quantile, and incomplete beta used by the theoretical curves are pure Python. plot.Lc, lines.Lc, plot.theorLc, lines.theorLc, and Pen draw with Matplotlib.

functions.name: Gini
functions.done: Gini coefficient, with the optional finite-sample correction.

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ineq))
x <- c(541, 1463, 2445, 3438, 4437, 5401, 6392, 8304, 11904, 22261)
one <- function() Gini(x)
invisible(one())
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import statistics
import time

from ineq.measures import Gini


x = [541, 1463, 2445, 3438, 4437, 5401, 6392, 8304, 11904, 22261]

def one():
    return Gini(x)

one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print("%.17g" % statistics.median(elapsed))

functions.name: Pen
functions.done: Draws Pen's parade with Matplotlib and returns the ordered heights and population shares.

check.case: Ten-class x and n, scaled TRUE and FALSE. R time is the coordinate arithmetic only, not a graphics device.

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ineq))
x <- c(541, 1463, 2445, 3438, 4437, 5401, 6392, 8304, 11904, 22261)
n <- c(482, 825, 722, 690, 661, 760, 745, 2140, 1911, 1024)
pen_coords <- function(scaled) {
  o <- order(x)
  xx <- x[o]
  nn <- n[o]
  if (scaled) xx <- xx / mean(xx)
  shares <- cumsum(c(0, nn)) / sum(nn)
  list(y = xx, p = shares, mean = mean(xx))
}
one <- function() pen_coords(TRUE)
invisible(one())
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
